arguments.prompt:
Create a professional native detailed pixel-art animation SOURCE ATLAS of Night Sentinel, EXACT selected incarnation: Doom Eternal (2020), generic adult Night Sentinel guard.

APPEARANCE AND EQUIPMENT: Closed steel Sentinel helmet, dark olive and silver medieval technological plate, blue cloth accents, physical Sentinel spear; chosen unnamed adult guard. Specified physical equipment: Sentinel spear. Selected action: Estoc de la lance sentinelle. All adult humanoids and robots retain their complete source anatomy. The alien/robot is not humanized. Preserve natural limb count and full equipment. Crouching is naturally shorter; all poses share the same body scale.

Practical nonsexual game animation presentation. Recognizable clean detailed 16-bit sprites, no photorealistic rendering. All figures face screen-right in the same coherent three-quarter side view. Full bodies and full equipment entirely inside each cell with generous clear transparent gutters. Never cut off feet, head, weapon barrel or cloth. Same source design and scale in all forty-eight pictures.

REQUIRED OUTER MARGIN: at least 40 transparent pixels around the entire atlas on ALL FOUR sides. Every head, foot and weapon tip must remain well inside those margins. Make figures small enough for clear gutters. Every acting group uses frame1prepare, frame2aim, frame3release or activation, frame4recover.

STRICT LAYOUT: EXACTLY FORTY-EIGHT complete SEPARATE figures in EIGHT COLUMNS by SIX ROWS, regular 8 x 6 grid. Transparent background. No grid lines, labels, numbers, text, panels, floor, cast shadow, scenery or other people. Each consecutive group of FOUR figures forms a genuine FOUR-FRAME sequence, FOUR independently drawn DIFFERENT poses, never cloned bodies. Every row has eight figures, not seven or nine. No detached effects or weapon fragments between cells.

ROW 1 columns1-4 INTRO: calm preparation with reference equipment without attack, four distinct readiness poses. Columns5-8 OUTRO: lower hands or equipment, turn slightly, settle and prepare to leave; four different calm poses, no attack.
ROW 2 columns1-4 ROUND VICTORY: restrained personal acknowledgment, equipment safe, four clear distinct poses. Columns5-8 ROUND DEFEAT: catch breath, lower shoulders, recover posture and settle without injury or attack.
ROW 3 columns1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Brace actual Sentinel spear, one controlled local physical strike, recover; no detached energy wave. Solo non-graphic acting only. Columns5-8 MATCH VICTORY: calm individual recognition gesture, equipment lowered safely, visibly distinct from round victory. Never attack in victory.
ROW 4 columns1-4 MATCH DEFEAT: slowly lower posture, bow head or settle shoulders, regain balance, settle; no injury. Columns5-8 SUPER: Brace actual Sentinel spear, one controlled local physical strike, recover; no detached energy wave. This is a separate newly drawn sequence, different from the finishing presentation and all other rows.
ROW 5 columns1-4 IDLE: four subtle breathing or weight-transfer poses, safe equipment, no offensive effects. Columns5-8 RUN: four clear complete source-appropriate locomotion cycle drawings retaining equipment safely (for VEGA console use the diagnostic standby transition described above).
ROW 6 columns1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Brace actual Sentinel spear, one controlled local physical strike, recover; no detached energy wave. These four drawings are separate from both super and finishing presentation. Columns5-8 HIT REACTION: brief non-graphic protective recoil, catch balance, recover, settle, no injury or blood.

No victim, opponent, wounds, blood, corpse or death spectacle. Quiet intro/outro/victory/defeat/idle/run/hit sequences do not attack, fire or emit offensive effects. No generalized glow, floating aura or borrowed ability. Only the specified real reference equipment and local effect at the correct release pose. Retain all 48 full figures separated by transparent margins.
